conventions.rotation: eye_rotation_L/R (and _quat, _matrix): rotation of the eye's line of sight from straight ahead (forward_world), world frame, XYZ Euler, radians, torsion-free (Listing's law). eye_rotation_matrix @ forward_world = gaze_direction_world, which passes through fixation_target_world
conventions.globe_rotation: globe_rotation_L/R: rigid rotation of the eyeball mesh about its centre from the rest pose (what the renderer applies); differs from eye_rotation by angle kappa
conventions.gaze_direction: visual axis (line to the fovea); both pass through fixation_target_world
conventions.optical_axis: geometric axis of the globe; kappa deg temporal of the visual axis
conventions.pixels: origin top-left corner, x right, y down
conventions.pupil_center_2D: camera_matrix @ pupil_center_3D: pinhole projection of the 3D centre of the pupil disc (no corneal refraction; the refracted image centre is pupil_center_2D_apparent, 0.4-1.3 px away)
